description: A man in a dark coat stands over a reclining woman in a grey gown in a candlelit, gilded room with drapes. His hand rests on her head and his other hand hovers near her shoulder. In the foreground a wooden tub is full of iron rods and rope, and seated people in 18th-century dress hold rods from it. Musicians with a violin and cello stand in the background crowd. No visible text, frame or border.
